name: defense-contractor-bias-coverage-lab
description: DefenseTech bias-coverage scaffolding for population-level analysis of AI used in DIB workforce decisions — veteran preference (VEVRAA / 38 USC 4212), security-clearance access patterns (EO 12968 + adjudicative guidelines), sub-contractor flow-down equity, equal-pay (29 CFR Part 1602), Section 503 disability, NISPOM insider-threat program disparities.
